title: Pure Azamina

allow.Deception of the Sinful Spoils: Shared Sinful Spoils card built for Azamina: tributes a monster to search any Azamina card, and drains LP while you control an Azamina monster.
allow.Sinful Spoils Subdual: Shared Sinful Spoils card: adds or summons Queen Azamina, a Level 8 Illusion, from the Deck.
allow.Sinful Spoils of the White Forest: Shared Sinful Spoils card: summons an Illusion from the hand or Fusion Summons an Azamina with real materials, and counts as a Sinful Spoils card to send.
allow.Diabellstar the Black Witch: Diabell witch the page pivots through: sets a Sinful Spoils Spell/Trap from the Deck, which the Azamina Spells then send as their cost.
allow.Diabellstar Vengeance: Diabell witch that is always treated as a Sinful Spoils card: a cost the Azamina Spells can send, and a Fiend for Moa Regina and Sol Erysichthon.

summary: Azamina cards with generic staples, plus the shared Sinful Spoils cards and two Diabell witches that feed them; the White Forest Synchro engine has its own list. The Azamina Spells and Trap summon an Azamina Fusion without materials: they send one Sinful Spoils card from your hand or field per 4 Levels of the Fusion. Queen Azamina, the newest monster, is always treated as a Sinful Spoils card and summons herself whenever an effect sends or banishes her, so she pays for a Fusion and stays on the field. Elzette, Azamina of the White Forest Fusion Summons an Azamina with real materials every turn. Saint Azamina, a Level 10, summons another Azamina from the Deck or Extra Deck. Azamina, the Level 12 boss, can't be destroyed by effects and shuts off their 0-ATK monsters.
